brief.headline: A hot, sunny Okanagan week (32° peaks) pushes daytime golf outside — so B9 wins on evenings, night-owl access, and midday heat-escape bays.

vernonSignals.signal: Sustained heat: 32°/32°/29°/28°/31° across the week — midday outdoor rounds get uncomfortable, opening a cool-bay 'heat escape' angle.
Wednesday chance of showers breaks the sun streak — a natural weather-proof booking prompt.
Warm evenings and clear skies favor after-work and late-night league play in climate-controlled bays.
Federal public servants returning to office four days a week signals a broader return-to-in-person culture — relevant to corporate team-outing demand.

topActions.action: Launch a midday 'Heat Escape' block promoting cool, private bays during 32° peaks.
topActions.why: Two straight 32° days make midday outdoor golf unpleasant; B9's climate-controlled bays are the obvious alternative.
topActions.benefit: Fills traditionally soft daytime hours and reinforces premium comfort positioning.
topActions.nib2Help: Draft the offer copy, social captions, and a member text.
topActions.prompt: Draft a 'Heat Escape' midday promo for Back Nine Vernon this week: private climate-controlled Full Swing bays as the antidote to 32°C Okanagan afternoons. Give me polished website blurb, 3 Instagram captions (one spicier), and a short friendly member text pushing 11am-3pm slots.

topActions.action: Push a Wednesday rain-day booking nudge tied to the showers forecast.
topActions.why: Wednesday's chance of showers is a clean weather-proof trigger to drive bookings.
topActions.benefit: Converts a weather dip into filled bays; positions B9 as reliable regardless of sky.
topActions.prompt: Write a short Wednesday 'chance of showers' booking nudge for Back Nine Vernon — weather-proof indoor golf regardless of the forecast. Give me an SMS blast, an Instagram story line, and one email subject + 2-sentence body.

topActions.action: Promote warm-evening night-owl and after-work league slots.
topActions.why: Clear warm evenings are prime for social, competitive after-work play in comfortable bays.
topActions.benefit: Drives evening bookings and seeds league/membership interest.
topActions.nib2Help: Draft evening-focused content and a league teaser.
topActions.prompt: Draft after-work and night-owl promo content for Back Nine Vernon this warm week: 24/7 access, private bays, competitive vibe. Include 2 Instagram captions, a night-owl Owl-tier membership angle, and a teaser for a weeknight evening league.

topActions.action: Open a corporate team-outing outreach pass to categories, riding return-to-office momentum.
topActions.why: Return-to-office culture nationally supports in-person team activities; corporate memberships are a top priority.
topActions.benefit: Higher-value corporate memberships and event bookings.
topActions.nib2Help: Build the target category list and outreach templates.
topActions.prompt: Build a corporate outreach plan for Back Nine Vernon targeting business CATEGORIES in Vernon (realtors, insurance/financial offices, breweries, dental/medical clinics, auto dealerships, construction/trades firms). For each: how to find them and a warm, non-salesy pitch template for a team outing or Corporate membership. Include a subject line and 4-line email.

topActions.action: Seed a summer tournament/league built on the Beyond the Grass competitive layer.
topActions.why: Tournaments and BTG usage are strategic priorities and fit the social summer-evening energy.
topActions.benefit: Recurring bookings, member retention, and premium ecosystem positioning.
topActions.prompt: Design a summer weeknight simulator league for Back Nine Vernon tied to Beyond the Grass (one leaderboard, season-long Cup layer). Give me format, length, entry structure, prize/perk ideas, and 2 promo captions positioning it as elevated competitive golf culture.

revenueOpportunities.text: Bundle a midday heat-escape 2-hour bay with cold drinks as a premium daytime package.
revenueOpportunities.prompt: Create a premium midday 'Heat Escape' package for Back Nine Vernon: 2-hour private bay + cold drinks, priced as an experience not a discount. Give me the package description, what's included, and a warm sales reply for inquiries.

revenueOpportunities.text: Sell weeknight evening blocks to groups of 4 as a social outing alternative to a patio.
revenueOpportunities.prompt: Write a promo for Back Nine Vernon selling weeknight evening private-bay group outings for 4 as the elevated alternative to a crowded summer patio. Include booking copy and 2 social captions.

revenueOpportunities.text: Offer a rain-contingency booking hook for Wednesday to capture last-minute demand.
revenueOpportunities.prompt: Draft a same-day 'showers rolling in?' last-minute booking offer for Back Nine Vernon Wednesday, driving fill of open bays. Keep it premium, not desperate — SMS + story format.

premiumPositioning.text: Frame B9 as the climate-controlled counterpart to outdoor summer golf — same game, zero heat, full privacy.
premiumPositioning.prompt: Write elevated website-ready copy positioning Back Nine Vernon as the climate-controlled counterpart to Okanagan summer golf: private Full Swing bays, no 32° heat, total privacy, year-round. Polished version plus a slightly spicier version.

premiumPositioning.text: Lean into modern sports-culture momentum (Rogers/MLSE) to position B9 as serious, elevated golf — not a rec-room sim.
premiumPositioning.prompt: Draft a brand social post for Back Nine Vernon riding the elevated-sports-culture moment: premium, data-driven Full Swing golf as part of the Beyond the Grass ecosystem, not a discount sim rental. Give polished + spicier versions.

competitiveAdvantage.text: Hammer the 24/7 access edge — golf at 6am or midnight when nothing else is open.
competitiveAdvantage.prompt: Write 3 social captions for Back Nine Vernon emphasizing 24/7 access as the structural advantage — golf at any hour, private bay, your schedule. Sharp, confident, no cringe.

competitiveAdvantage.text: Emphasize Full Swing data (ball flight, shot metrics) as the practice edge outdoor ranges can't match.
competitiveAdvantage.prompt: Draft content for Back Nine Vernon highlighting Full Swing simulator data — real shot metrics and feedback to actually improve — as an advantage over a hot outdoor range. One post + one short blurb.

contentIdeas.text: '32° outside, 21° in the bay' — heat-escape reel showing the comfort contrast this week.
contentIdeas.prompt: Script a short Instagram reel for Back Nine Vernon contrasting a 32°C Okanagan afternoon with a cool, private Full Swing bay. Give me the shot list, on-screen text, and caption.

contentIdeas.text: Wednesday showers post: 'The only forecast that matters indoors is your ball speed.'
contentIdeas.prompt: Write an Instagram post for Back Nine Vernon tied to Wednesday's chance of showers — weather-proof indoor golf. Give me caption + 3 hashtag-light tags, premium tone.

contentIdeas.text: Warm-evening 'night owl' post spotlighting late-night bay sessions under the 24/7 model.
contentIdeas.prompt: Create a night-owl themed social post for Back Nine Vernon promoting late-evening private-bay sessions during this week's warm nights, tied to the Owl membership tier. Caption + story line.

contentIdeas.text: Okanagan summer 'play twice' angle: outdoor round in the AM, sim session to dial in the swing after.
contentIdeas.prompt: Write a post for Back Nine Vernon pitching the Okanagan golfer's double: morning outdoor round, afternoon Full Swing session to fix what went wrong. Caption, polished + spicier.

contentIdeas.prompt: Draft an Instagram story poll for Back Nine Vernon: '18 in 32° heat vs a cool private bay?' plus a witty follow-up frame driving to book. Give me the exact text.

contentIdeas.text: 'Beat the heat leaderboard' — this week's best sim scores posted, tying into Beyond the Grass.
contentIdeas.prompt: Write a social post + weekly recap format for Back Nine Vernon showcasing a 'Beat the Heat' weekly leaderboard tied to Beyond the Grass. Include caption and a template for posting scores.

contentIdeas.text: Behind-the-bays: what a private Full Swing setup actually looks/feels like vs assumptions.
contentIdeas.prompt: Script a short behind-the-scenes reel for Back Nine Vernon showing what a private Full Swing bay experience really feels like — premium, quiet, dialed. Shot list + caption.

contentIdeas.text: 'Summer patio is full — book a bay instead' cheeky evening social post.
contentIdeas.prompt: Write a cheeky-but-premium Instagram caption for Back Nine Vernon positioning a private bay as the better summer evening than a packed patio. Polished + spicier versions.

contentIdeas.text: Corporate teaser tied to return-to-office culture: 'Team's back in the office — reward them.'
contentIdeas.prompt: Draft a LinkedIn-style post for Back Nine Vernon aimed at Vernon business owners: teams back in-person deserve a team outing in private simulator bays. Professional, warm, one clear CTA.

contentIdeas.text: Membership fit explainer: Owl vs Birdie vs Eagle for the summer-and-beyond golfer.
contentIdeas.prompt: Write a clear, non-salesy membership explainer post for Back Nine Vernon comparing Owl, Birdie, and Eagle tiers by lifestyle fit. Verify tier framing against the memberships page and lead with value, not price.

contentIdeas.text: 'Golf year-round' post reframing summer sign-ups as a 12-month advantage, not seasonal.
contentIdeas.prompt: Create a post for Back Nine Vernon reframing a summer membership as year-round value — indoor golf through Okanagan winters too. Caption + short blurb, premium tone.

corporateTargets.prompt: Write a warm outreach email for Back Nine Vernon to Vernon real estate brokerages pitching private-bay client-appreciation events and a Corporate membership. Explain how to find brokerage team leads and give subject line + 4-line body.

corporateTargets.prompt: Write a Corporate membership outreach template for Back Nine Vernon aimed at Vernon trades/construction and auto dealership businesses for team outings and morale events. Include how to find ops managers and a concise pitch.

memberGrowth.prompt: Write a warm, low-pressure in-person and follow-up script for Back Nine Vernon staff to convert a heat-escape day guest into a Birdie membership conversation. No hard sell.

memberGrowth.prompt: Draft a friendly member text for Back Nine Vernon inviting members to bring a friend for a warm-evening bay session, with a soft nod to guest privileges. Casual tone.

memberGrowth.prompt: Create a short campaign for Back Nine Vernon targeting the after-work crowd to convert into Owl or Birdie members, using this week's warm evenings. Give 2 captions + one email.

tournamentIdeas.prompt: Design a weeknight 'Beat the Heat' summer league for Back Nine Vernon on Full Swing, feeding a Beyond the Grass leaderboard. Give format, weeks, entry, perks, and 2 promo captions.
